digest.component_or_area: outbound link emission and mapping configuration
propositions: Link-relation mapping is hardcoded in two backend adapters via RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK; S4 makes it config-driven while preserving skip semantics.

REMOVE emission silently drops remapped (config-overridden) remote link types because built-in reverse map JIRA_LINK_TO_RELATION does not know the override, causing remote links to be spuriously adopted rather than removed.
A single effective_link_map must govern both ADD (_diff_links) and REMOVE (_diff_link_removals) via a shared _resolve_link resolver that handles skip, override, and built-in swap preservation.

REMOVE attribution must be config-aware: when a remote link's opaque vendor type is not in the built-in reverse map, attempt to recover its relation by inverting the effective link_map; a still-unresolved relation is genuinely unmapped and adopted.
Undeclared link-type values in the overridden link_map must fail closed via validate() and Capability.has_link_types, raising MappingConfigError on project load.
Both ADD and REMOVE must emit the same overridden vendor_type (not re-substituted) so that add and remove reference a single configured link type throughout its lifecycle.
